scholarly_anchors: Layton, B. (1987). The Gnostic Scriptures. Doubleday.
Robinson, J. M., ed. (1988). The Nag Hammadi Library in English, 3rd ed. Harper & Row.
Turner, J. D. (1990). Trimorphic Protennoia. In Nag Hammadi Codices XI, XII, XIII. Brill.
encoding_notes: Trimorphic Protennoia presents a unique cosmological pattern: a single divine figure (Protennoia/Barbelo/First Thought) descends three times in three forms — Voice, Speech, and Logos — each penetrating deeper into materiality. This is structurally distinct from all 14 existing schemas: it is neither serial emanation (Plotinus), nor error-driven branching (Valentinian), nor mission-driven branching (Manichaean), but parallel self-expression of the same divine identity in three simultaneous aspects. The Five Seals at the terminal descent represent the Gnostic baptismal rite of illumination.

nodes.name: Invisible Spirit
nodes.description: The utterly transcendent, unknowable source. Silent and invisible. Protennoia emerges from this source as its First Thought.

nodes.name: Protennoia / Barbelo (First Thought)
nodes.description: The First Thought of the Invisible Spirit — Protennoia ('First Thought'). She is the same divine figure who descends three times in three forms.

nodes.name: First Descent: Voice (Phone)
nodes.description: Protennoia's first descent into the lower realms as Voice — pure sound that penetrates Chaos. She reveals her existence to those trapped below but does not yet give form or liberation. The Voice awakens.

nodes.name: Second Descent: Speech (Phthongos)
nodes.description: Protennoia's second descent as Speech — structured sound that gives form to the awakened. She clothes herself in the likeness of the powers below to move among them undetected. Speech gives form.

nodes.name: Third Descent: Logos / Christ
nodes.description: Protennoia's third and final descent as Logos — the Word made flesh. She puts on the garment of Jesus, enters the material world, and liberates the souls through the Five Seals. Logos liberates.

nodes.name: Five Seals (Baptismal Illumination)
nodes.description: The Five Seals — the Gnostic baptismal rite administered by the Logos-descended Protennoia. Through this rite, souls are stripped of ignorance and clothed in light. The mechanism of rescue from materiality.

nodes.name: Rescued Souls / Luminous Ones
nodes.description: The Gnostic elect — souls liberated from the material world through the Five Seals. They return to the light, completing the triple-descent rescue mission.

edges.description: First Thought emanates from the Invisible Spirit
Protennoia descends as Voice — first form, awakening
Protennoia descends as Speech — second form, giving shape
Protennoia descends as Logos/Christ — third form, liberation
Logos administers the Five Seals baptismal rite
Souls contracted/gathered from material dispersal back to light

material_world_node.description: Add an explicit Material World / Chaos node at the bottom that all three descents penetrate into, rather than having the rescue emerge only from Logos. This would add 1 node and 2 additional edges (Voice->Material, Speech->Material).
material_world_node.scholarly_support: Turner (1990) emphasises that each descent penetrates deeper into the same material realm, suggesting a shared target node.
